name: Sapphire Systems Inc
old_description: Soon we will be delivering high-performance windows to both commercial and military customers.
about:
Sapphire Systems Inc. was incorporated in 2007 by Charles Allmon and John Outwater in a garage laboratory to commercialize crystal-growth innovations. The company soon moved to a larger facility in Bedford, Massachusetts, along the Route 128 corridor northwest of Boston, to develop larger systems and begin commercial production.

The company grows optical-quality sapphire plates using the Edge-defined, Film-fed Growth (EFG) method, which it considers ideal for large-area plates. Current production yields plates 15‑5/8 inches wide, with standard plates of 30 by 15‑5/8 inches by 3/8 inch thick planned for pilot production; larger plates are available on request. Sapphire Systems has also produced and sold optical sapphire fiber and sapphire ribbon for superconductor substrates.

Its customers span military and commercial markets. For defense, the firm supplies sensor windows, transparent armor, and bullet‑proof windows used on range finders, infrared cameras, and personnel protection systems. In semiconductor manufacturing, its sapphire components serve as windows, wafer carriers, and other hardware that withstand corrosive chip‑fabrication environments.

Sapphire Systems differentiates itself through its patented EFG growth technology and the scale of its plates, which it describes as among the largest commercially available. The company holds three U.S. patents, an R&D 100 Award, and an SBIR Award for its superconducting wire epitaxial growth process.

name: Sasquatch Water Company, LLC
old_description: Providing Central Oregon with safe, clean 12 step Reverse Osmosis filtered and Alkaline drinking water at an affordable price.
about:
Sasquatch Water Company, LLC operates from Redmond, Oregon, delivering purified alkaline drinking water and bagged ice to customers throughout Central Oregon. The company also designs and builds the Diamond Skid, an industrial-grade reverse osmosis system sold in domestic and international markets.

The core service is a 12-step reverse osmosis filtration process that employs more than 50 individual filters to produce alkaline water with a pH of 8.8. The process includes pre-filtration down to 20 microns, carbon filtration, a 5-micron pre-filter, a high-pressure stainless steel RO pump, a .0002-micron membrane, UV sterilization, and optional ozone treatment. Water is stored in FDA-approved tanks and repressurized for consistent delivery. In addition to water, the company produces two styles of bagged ice: Cristal Clear half-dome and nugget ice. On the equipment side, the Diamond Skid line features a powder-coated steel frame, prewired electrical panel, stainless steel booster pump, and components that carry NSF, FDA, UL, or ETL approvals. Models share a common footprint of 90″L × 30″W × 74″H and can be customized with feed pumps, TDS meters, water softeners, and chemical injection.

Residential and commercial customers in Central Oregon subscribe to 24/7 water delivery, while the Diamond Skid systems serve domestic and international buyers needing turnkey water purification for bottling, vending, or industrial processes. The company does not disclose specific client names or industry verticals beyond the general markets it addresses.

Sasquatch Water emphasizes purity and affordability, citing independent lab certification of its water and a filtration train designed to remove 99.9% of impurities from source, plumbing, and municipal lines. The Diamond Skid was developed to answer the call for pure, quality, consumable drinking water in varied feed-water conditions, with recovery rates up to 60% and salt rejection of 90–98%.

name: Saturn PCB Design, Inc.
old_description: Saturn PCB Design, Inc. is a printed circuit board design and manufacturing company headquartered in DeBary, Florida.
about:
Saturn PCB Design, Inc. is headquartered in DeBary, Florida. The company is led by President Kenneth J. Wood. A founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The company provides printed circuit board design, manufacturing, and assembly services, along with comprehensive electronic engineering. Its design capabilities span RF circuits, digital designs including DSP and FPGA, and low-level analog circuits. Manufacturing covers single-, double-, and multi-layer boards, while assembly delivers finished boards with components soldered. The firm also offers Design for Manufacture, Test, and Assembly (DFX) analysis, signal integrity management, and impedance control, using tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, and Mentor HyperLynx.

Saturn PCB serves customers worldwide across military, space, medical, industrial, and commercial sectors. The company emphasizes secure PCB solutions that meet government regulations for national security, cybersecurity, and supply chain transparency.

The company highlights its quality, service, and commitment to each project, citing competitive rates, quick turnaround times, and a high level of design communication through multiple channels. Its documented workflow structure and expertise in signal integrity are presented as key differentiators.

name: SauceWorks
old_description: Small Batch Gourmet Sauce Producer And Full Scale Co-Packing Facility
about:
SauceWorks is a small-batch gourmet sauce producer and full-scale co-packing facility based in Tacoma, Washington. The company operates an FDA-registered facility where it manufactures its own line of hot sauces, seasonings, and dry rubs while also providing contract manufacturing services for other brands.

The facility houses professional-grade stainless steel equipment designed to ensure consistent viscosity, precise pH balance, and rigorous sanitation across every batch. SauceWorks handles both small and large production runs, offering end-to-end co-packing that includes recipe scaling, bottling, labeling, and regulatory compliance. Its product portfolio spans hot sauces such as a chipotle blend and the Carolina Reaper–based Fear The Reaper, as well as dry rubs and seasonings sold directly to consumers.

The company serves two primary customer groups: retail buyers who purchase SauceWorks-branded products through its online store, and food brands seeking a co-packing partner to bring their own recipes to market. Its co-packing clients range from startups with a single recipe to established labels needing scalable production.

SauceWorks differentiates itself by emphasizing industrial-grade standards in a facility that exceeds typical home-kitchen operations, sourcing real peppers without fillers or artificial thickeners, and promising same-day shipment on direct orders with free shipping over $50. The founders’ stated philosophy is that heat should elevate flavor rather than overwhelm it.

name: Sauder Furniture and Design Studio
old_description: "Sauder's is simply an unexpected treasure, located in small town Roanoke. Great staff, great prices, great customer service. What more can you ask for? Check them out!"
about:
Sauder Furniture and Design Studio operates from a 20,000-square-foot showroom in Roanoke, Illinois, a small town in the central part of the state. The business traces its roots to 1907, when Grandpa Sauder opened the original store, and it has remained family-owned ever since. Today the company is led by fifth-generation owner Wade Sauder, who serves as president and customer relations associate, and fourth-generation co-owner Jeff Sauder, who oversees customer relations and flooring installation.

The store functions as a full-service furniture retailer and design studio. Its product assortment includes sofas, loveseats, chairs, recliners, sectionals, bedroom sets, mattresses, and dining-room pieces, along with a flooring selection covering carpet, hardwood, luxury vinyl plank, and tile. Beyond sales, the staff provides interior design consulting, measure-and-install services, and a professional installation team that handles everything from flooring to window treatments. Home decor, candles, and fashion accessories round out the offering.

The customer base is primarily residential, drawing from Roanoke and the surrounding Central Illinois region, with a broader reach across the Midwest. The company emphasizes its role as a community fixture, serving neighbors and friends through a team that includes in-house designers, delivery and installation crews, and customer relations specialists.

The Sauder family positions the business on a tradition of personal service that spans generations. Wade Sauder describes great customer service not just as a tradition but as a way of life, while Jeff Sauder highlights trust, relationships, and making every customer feel like part of the family. That heritage, combined with a full-service model under one roof, is presented as the core differentiator.

name: Saunders Machine Works
old_description: Optimize your setup with SMW fixture plates and work holding products.
about:
Saunders Machine Works is based in Zanesville, Ohio, where it develops and produces workholding hardware for CNC machining.

Its catalog centers on SMW fixture plates, a modular vise line called Mod Vise that offers smooth, serrated, and soft jaws along with custom pallets and fixtures, and the PuckChuck zero-point clamping system available in automatic and mechanical receiver models. The company also offers traditional CNC vises, accessory kits, quick-change fixturing components, pallets, and fixture pins.

The equipment targets machine shops and manufacturers that operate CNC mills and lathes.

Saunders Machine Works highlights benefits such as decreased spindle downtime, higher parts-per-cycle throughput, and full use of the machine work envelope. The product design incorporates color-coded plugs for repeatable setups, diamond pins for rapid alignment, and a modular vise system that removes the need for vise tramming.

name: Savant Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Need thousands of parts laser cut, bent, and powder coated under one roof? Savant Mfg is the place for you.
about:
Savant Manufacturing Inc. is based in Kinder, Louisiana. The company traces its roots to 1978 when founder Kevin Savant, then 14, built his first four-wheeler rack in his backyard using homemade tools and scrap metal. After years of part-time orders, the business was formalized in 1985 with a workshop on Highway 383 in Kinder, starting with one employee. The company remains a self-made, founder-owned operation.

SMI operates as a full-service metal fabrication and machine shop, offering laser cutting (including a 6 kW fiber laser), CNC bending (press brakes up to 12 feet wide), CNC milling and turning (Haas equipment), turret punching (two machines), plasma cutting, robotic welding, powder coating (automated line accommodating parts up to 60 inches wide), sanding, deburring, and PEM hardware insertion. The shop also provides engineering and design support using SolidWorks and AutoCAD, and maintains a FARO Arm CMM for inspection. They handle prototype through production volumes, with the capacity to produce thousands of parts under one roof.

The company originally specialized in ATV and UTV accessories—front and rear racks, drop racks, floor boards, gun racks, stick shifts, and similar items—custom-fitted to new models each year. Today, SMI serves a broader range of clients as a job shop, manufacturing, modifying, and repairing prototype and production parts for various industries across the southern United States, leveraging a network of partner shops for processes not performed in-house.

SMI emphasizes a quality system built on hiring for attitude, quality, cooperation, and growth, with quarterly employee reviews and multi-stage inspections (welders, buffers, painters, packers, shippers). The founder’s early experience shaped a culture of double-checking every weld and finish, and the automated powder-coat line ensures consistent, durable finishes. The company states its differentiator is a precise mix of quality, service, delivery, and price, staying on the cutting edge of manufacturing technology.

name: Savant Sheet Metal Fabrication Shop
old_description: contractors, architects, and building owners  in New Jersey, New York & the Tri-State Area Since 2010
about:
Savant Sheet Metal Fabrication Shop was founded in 2010 by co-founders Fabrizio Bird and Ruby Lock in the Bronx, New York. The company operates a fabrication facility in Newark, New Jersey, serving contractors, architects, and building owners across the Tri-State area.

The shop specializes in custom architectural and miscellaneous metal fabrication, working with materials such as galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, copper, brass, and composite panels. Its capabilities include fiber laser cutting, CNC bending and forming, CNC shearing, welding, soldering, and tube cutting, supported by multiple CNC bending machines, a CNC shearing machine, an axis CNC machine, and a CNC aluminum saw. The team provides drafting, shop drawings, 3D rendering, project management, and design consultation, handling everything from prototype and one-off pieces to production runs for commercial projects.

Savant serves the commercial construction sector, including general contractors, roofing and glazing contractors, and architects, with projects in hospitality, healthcare, education, retail, industrial facilities, multifamily residential, and government and municipal buildings. Notable work includes replicated historical cornices, custom cove ceiling light panels, and laser-cut window shadow boxes for a Bronx housing complex.

The company emphasizes craftsmanship and attention to detail, offering emergency fabrication services, fast quotes, and quick turnaround times to meet tight project schedules.
